# agentic-tasks

Task boards where people and agents claim and finish work.

Keywords: tasks,kanban,todo,project-management,agents,mcp,cli,collaboration.

- SDK: import { createTasks, createFileStore, trustedContext } from "agentic-tasks".
- Access: board roles (viewer, commenter, editor, owner) from agentic-identity.
- Claim rules: AGENTS.md in the repository.
